headline: Withdrawal Letter vs Records Request: Homeschooling Mid-Year Paperwork
sub: Most families withdrawing from a school need to send both.
items: Withdrawal letter: Your child is leaving, as of a date you set. Goes to the school office, hand-delivered if you can.
Records request: Send the cumulative file: transcripts, test results, health and any IEP records. Goes to the same office, as a separate letter.
